title: Benchmark run record v1
description: Target schema for every per-run record (device speed/memory/energy cells AND host-side quality reports). Existing files predate this schema and are normalized into results/summary/ by scripts/build_summary.py; new writers must emit these fields natively. Continuous-bench condition 2.

runtime.description: arm id, e.g. litert-lm / mlx-swift / llama.cpp / core-ai / cactus

engineVersion.description: REQUIRED for new rows (absent in pre-v1 records): the engine build that produced this row — tag, commit, or package version (e.g. v0.15.0, b8999, 60bd0d78). The v0.13.1-to-v0.15.0 re-measure had to reconstruct this from prose; never again.

engineArtifact.description: checksum or artifact name when the engine is a prebuilt binary

id.description: hf repo id or catalog id

quantization.description: rule 5: the recipe, visible per row

conditions.description: everything a fairness reviewer asks first

metrics.description: axis values; only the ones the task measures

coldRun.description: fresh engine process (cold regime); false = in-process repeat (warm)

firstEver.description: engine-cache build run for this (model, backend) on this device — reported separately, never pooled as the engine's speed

endurance.description: endurance-chat-<N>m session stats (additive, 2026-09-01; methodology/endurance.md). Derived within ONE session — never pooled across sessions. The full per-turn series is raw: the .turns.ndjson sidecar named by turnsSidecar, beside the record.

conversationRollovers.description: fresh conversations forced by the context budget (full re-prefill); the chat-app rollover, recorded instead of silently widening the budget

status.description: completed | crash | hang | empty-output — failed sessions keep their record and partial series (failed-runs-stay)

decodeDecayPercent.description: (first-window - last-window)/first-window x100; positive = slower at the end

memorySlopeMBPerTurn.description: least-squares slope of after-turn phys_footprint (memory.md basis); persistent positive slope across rollovers = leak-class signal

turnsSidecar.description: basename of the per-turn NDJSON sidecar in the same campaign dir (stored-report-rule)

rawLog.description: repo-relative path to the raw log (rule 5)
